QF.id: Concept and Role of Mutual Fund_6

question.text: Per the current NISM V-A workbook, how many sub-categories are permitted under Equity Schemes by SEBI?

explanation.text: The Logic: The current NISM V-A workbook (November 2025) states that Equity Schemes have 11 sub-categories, with Flexi-Cap Fund listed as the 11th: Multi Cap, Large Cap, Large & Mid Cap, Mid Cap, Small Cap, Dividend Yield, Value/Contra, Focused, Sectoral/Thematic, ELSS, and Flexi-Cap Fund. Each AMC can have only ONE scheme per sub-category, with limited exceptions such as index funds and sectoral/thematic funds. The Trap: The pre-Flexi-Cap original 2017 list had 10. Selecting "10" reflects the older list rather than the current workbook. 16 is the count of Debt fund sub-categories; 6 is the Hybrid count. Cross-Exam Context: NISM V-B goes deeper into each sub-category with minimum investment thresholds (e.g., Large Cap must invest a minimum of 80% in top 100 stocks by market cap). The distinction between Multi-Cap (minimum 25% each in large, mid, and small caps) and Flexi-Cap (full discretion) is also tested in V-B and XII.
